turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
AI adoption accelerated and data center investment increased again to meet strong demand. Power demand for our data centers is a growing focus.
Revenue grew 18% year over year. Azure demand was exceptional and we raised capital expenditure guidance for data center investment.
Is power demand a constraint on data center investment?
Power demand is a real constraint and we are investing in supply. Cloud demand remains strong with pricing power intact.
